scope: Immutable local evidence packaging only. No app changes, rerun, Git mutation, CI/deployment or live acceptance is claimed by this manifest.

source.bridge: Only smoke helper root URL equivalence changed after normal build. App/runtime paths and fixtures unchanged; smoke repeated. Final CI artifact will be independently compared.

mappingNotes: Report names browser-normal-result.json and browser-pages-result.json map to identically named .json.gz archives.
Original raw bytes are recoverable with gzip -dc. SHA256 is recorded both before and after compression.
Command receipts are preserved verbatim under commands/, including original nonzero exits and successful retests. The Pages browser exit 2 remains MANUAL_PENDING; final adjudication is separate.
SourcePath records temporary provenance, not an online download link. No credentials or signed download URLs are included.

Eleven screenshot PNG bytes are copied unchanged to docs/screenshots/bf009-016/. Source PNG/HTML/TXT and derivative crop PNG files are intentionally omitted; exact raw SHA/bytes and rationale are recorded under omittedRelatedArtifacts. Structured source and interaction JSON, source manifest, visual review/crop manifest, seven original full pages and focus/menu context remain archived.

securityReview.selection: Only current /tmp/xk-bf009-016 files plus four explicit BF016 validator files; excludes this packaging helper/receipt/log and unrelated temporary files.

limitations: Local tested-source fingerprint is not a commit, CI artifact, deployment or public live-site acceptance result. Root separately owns these stages.
The 32-case URL classification JSON has no separate OS process receipt in the supplied inputs; it remains scoped to parser/URL cases as originally recorded.
The targeted overlap receipt records actual tool-observed process exit 0; it is distinct from run-with-evidence.py receipts.
Initial command/tool failures and retests are retained as supplied. No missing original outcome is reconstructed.
Manifest excludes its own hash to avoid self-reference. changed-files.json is hashed separately; packaging command receipt is a separate generated artifact.

Source public-page HTML/plain text and source/derivative image bulk were not indiscriminately copied. OmittedRelatedArtifacts documents exact supplied bytes; the evidence selection retains structured extracts, decisions and original website acceptance screenshots.
